note: Ironclad Forge Colossus (unit identity, Ironclad): a soot-iron golem with a lit furnace grille, twin smokestacks, ember eyes, a brass jaw, brass-knuckled fists, a team apron and a slag maul. Tier II brow, cheek and knee plates, a third pauldron lame and brass maul collars; tier III bone horns, pauldron spikes, ember greaves and a spiked maul. No back flag.
